entities.summary: Jaime José Serra Puche is a Mexican economist. He is a partner of the SAI Law and Economics firm in Mexico (sai.com.mx). His professional practice includes the design of investment strategies in Mexico for foreign companies and advice to Mexican companies interested in becoming regional players in North America.
